description: 인천국제공항공사_제2터미널 화물기 운항 현황 상세 조회 [airports] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 인천국제공항공사. 인천국제공항공사가 제공하는 “제2터미널 화물기 운항 현황 상세 조회”는 인천공항 T2 화물기의 출발·도착 상황을 실시간에 가깝게 파악할 수 있도록 설계된 공공데이터입니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 인천국제공항공사. Its tags are 연결편, 연결일자, 화물, 2터미널, 북측. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
